title: Chemotaxis with tomography
summary: Cells encounter a diverse array of physical and chemical signals as they navigate their natural surroundings. However, their response to the simultaneous presence of multiple cues remains elusive. Particularly, the impact of topography alongside a chemotactic gradient on cell migratory behavior remains insufficiently explored. In this paper, we investigate the effects of topographical obstacles during chemotaxis.
